notes.title: Final Update (v1.1)
notes.content:
HotFix 01 Aug 2024 : Servers without password wasn't listed. Thanks to foxman27 for the report
HotFix 15 Aug 2024 : Fixed the permanent tackle immunity. Thanks to StonerRabbit for the report. The "canon ball" can now strip your target. (Request from Vagelv Niko)

[h3]Tearing clothes :[/h3]
You can now sacrifice your clothes to free yourself from your opponent's grip by simply by pressing the jump key. This sacrifice comes at a cost: you won't be able to use your hands (punch, clinch, goalkeeping ...). You also take more damage when you tackle and you loose precision when you loose all your clothes.
To recover your clothes, you'll need a green booster. Red boosters also allow you to use your hands, but for few seconds. Note : If you're grabbed for too long and too often, your clothes will tear too.

It's an idea I had early on in the game's development, and I've finally made up ...

[h3]New game mode : Goal wall :[/h3]  (Request from Salvo k27 & ÄPX-NE\/EC)
Goals can now put a barrier you need to destroy before being able to goal. 3 shoot are required except if you use a red booster. Note : You can't damage the barrier when it blinks red.

[h3]Celebration Skip :[/h3] (Request from ÄPX-NE\/EC & akadeim & ミ★ AMIRMJX ★彡)
You can now skip the post goal celebration phase. Just press the "E" key. More than half player need to do this action. If you skip the hate phase, the winning team loose their pants.
Note : If you're do this early you can even skip the slow mo phase.

[h3]New movement :[/h3] (Request from liberator100)
You can now perform a bicycle to intercept ball going above you. Just hold the right click and press the jump key.  If you press forward the shoot go forward, if you press backward the shoot goes behind your character.
Note : It's a really risky move, I failed 90% of the time, high invest, low income ...

[h3]Map variant :[/h3] (Request from ÄPX-NE\/EC)
The "Training Day" map have a variant called "Parking" with pillards you can use to trick your opponnents. They can be destroyed.

[h3]Increased shooting distance and ball bounce :[/h3] (Request from Mitovskill)
The ball goes 20% farther and bounce more. To compensate, I've reduced the precision when you aim for the goal.

[h3]Increased Bot difficulty on hard :[/h3]
They can pass, teleport, long shoot and get one random booster every 30 second.

[h3]Improved clinch success rate :[/h3]
It should be a little easier to grab your opponent, it's faster and more responsive. But it's still hard to grab a moving player.

[h3]Others stuff :[/h3]
- Server password (Request from HOONSIX & Bitcoin Baron)
- More max stamina recover when you use a blue booster
- The looby UI now blink on buttons that need to be clicked to start a game.
- Automatic retrigger shoot when you hold the right or left click and you miss the ball.
- Punch and kick effect in red or hate mode.
- Sightly increased the ball control by increasing the size of foot hit boxes.
- Rank reset


[h3]Fixes :[/h3]
- In some cases the character was punching instead for passing. (Report from richard_morris)
- The incorrect spawn position for Stadium and Park maps.
- Unregistered goals on District map. I've strongly reduced the bounce to prevent the ball from bouncing before being detected.
- The weird 180° ragdoll rotation when getting up.
- The "name server warning" wasn't translated.
- Reduced by 20% the size of textures, games should load a lil faster.
- Names that doesn't appear in lobby (I hope it works now).
- Beeing able to goal behind the goal net :/
- Improved clinch ragdoll transition to reduce player arm stretching
- Reduced hands shaking during clinch

I have made a lot of small modifications for this update. New bugs may appear, please let me know.
I stop here for No Fair Play, I'll only correct bugs or do some small modifications. I'll now focus on Darkness Arises after a short break. I really need it !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148270/Darkness_Arises/

notes.title: Update V1.0 & end of Early access
notes.content:
[h3]Parkour Mode Update :[/h3]
You can now create a lobby in Parkour Mode and play as teams. The team with the most targets wins the game ! You can also play cooperatively by putting all the players in a single team and try to achieve the best time or simply improve your skills.

The "District" map is now availaible in Parkour Mode.
Finally, the number of friends playing No Fair Play is displayed in the main menu. If you click on it, the Steam Overlay will open and you'll be able to join your friends easily.

Update 07/28 : Added 2 more music

Note : Parkour mode don't support bots or the reconnect system for now.
Again if you have an issue don't be afraid to contact me.


[h3]End of Early Access :[/h3]
In few days the game will leave the Early Access. I think I've fulfilled all my promises except for dedicated servers. I'm now planning to start a new project. No Fair Play was my first attempt to create an online multiplayer game. I've made a lot of mistakes, but I've also won a lot of experience and I'll be able to develop a new game much more quickly. 

Of course, if you have any problems with No Fair Play, I won't give up on you and I'll keep working to fix bugs, game balancing ... 
For No Fair Play owners, the next game will be cheaper for you if you are interested, just stay tuned ;)

notes.title: New trailer, future of the game and V0.94
notes.content:
[h3]New trailer :[/h3]
It's been a while since I made a trailer while the game has seen several additions such as superpowers, new maps, new game mode, new targeting system, goalkeeping, and the new wallhack system. So I've made a trailer to illustrate all these changes, here it is :
[previewyoutube=Sch3D9aRS6E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Future of the game :[/h3]
We're approaching version 1.0 and the game will be leaving early access at that point. I said early access would last 6 months, so I went a bit beyond what I had in mind. I think I've made every possible development and marketing mistake with No Fair Play. But I also learned a lot from this first game. This experience and even the elements developed with No Fair Play could help me to develop a new title much more quickly !
I'm really thinking about it, something really different, with perhaps a bonus for No Fair Play players ? ;)

For the 1.0 of No Fair Play, I'm going to add a new map for the parkour mode based on the District map and new musics. A lot of players fail in parkour mode, is it too difficult? Not interesting enough? Unfortunately I have no feedback with this mode ...

[h3]Update V0.94 :[/h3]
Increased the spawn rate of "super candies".
Add random super candies on all maps
Reduced Red power duration
Increased the ball impact with red power on character.
Some minor lighting modifications.

- reducing ball control loss when the ball goes on the side of your character

- Reducing Ragdoll impact, the character was projected violently, which can lead to synchronization problems.

- Fixed the 30min option in lobby.

notes.title: Update V0.91+0.92 : New Maps + Critical Bug
notes.content:
[h2]V0.92[/h2]
[h3]New map and offline mode[/h3]
Add new the new map "stadium", request by 野牛冲锋  and gideon.
Add offline mode, request from mamm0th51

[h3]Game Modification[/h3]
You can now tackle even if your stamina is low

[h3]Bugs :[/h3]
- The camera didn't get back to the player at the end of the round
- The blue team was able to use their hand (goalkeeping) outside the goal zone

[h2]V0.91[/h2]
[h3]New Map :[/h3]
野牛冲锋 requested a large map with fewer elements to make passes more important. I hesitated to make a soccer stadium but this will kill the spirit of the game, so I decided to make a Park. It's more interresting I think, but I may be wrong...

[h3]Critical bug :[/h3]
Multiplayer was broken because of the translation of the game... The lobby use english words to check if a player is ready, so in chinese version for example, the game was simply considered that the player wasn't ready. So I've removed the translation of keywords like "Ready".

I'm really sorry, but I'm working alone so I can't test everything. If you don't contact me directly, errors won't be corrected.

[h3]Other changes :[/h3]
Now at the end of a match the camera will show the best player for 3 seconds.

notes.title: Update V0.87 - V0.89
notes.content:
V0.89 : Interface translation
The game is now translated at 99%, I used a translation software so it's far from perfect. If you want to help you're welcome.

V0.87 : Goalkeeping improvement :
From now on, when a player is close to his side's goal, he will use his hands automatically to stop the ball.
The accuracy of shots has been increased to compensate (when there are more than 4 players) and spawning position have change to avoid scoring a goal at the start of a round.

Dives into the air is now possible. Keep in mind that this is an emergency function, as it may not be a good idea to use it. 
Bots have been slightly improved to cope with this function. Here's a video :
[previewyoutube=Wh1yZcDXbqs;full][/previewyoutube]

One person complained of motion sickness, so I've made a few improvements in that direction :
- The aiming reticle has now a permanent center point.
- The vignette effect has been increased
- The camera is more responsive. 
- Camera transitions are slower and limited to a single player (the one who scored the goal).

If you have any issue let me know ...

notes.title: Update V0.79 - Shader Optimization
notes.content:
Many players complain about the lack of optimization of the game. Moreover, the future map that's coming is more complex than the previous ones, which means the problem will only get worse ! So I worked on it by reducing the complexity of the shaders. The game is slightly less beautiful but the number of [u]FPS increases by +50% to +100%[/u] ! (especially with old configurations). Maps should also load faster.

I also had to sacrifice the old wallhack system based on transparency, now objects aren't rendered transparent when they are between the character and the camera. Instead, an opening is created to see through. Not everyone will like it, I can still improve the effect if necessary, like increasing the size of the hole, just let me know.

(if you want to know more there is always the video I made here : [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mncJ9gEjQo4]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mncJ9gEjQo4 [/url])

Final point, the crosshair is now permanent even if you're not near the ball. It will help you to anticipate a shot ...

I know, it's not the new map yet, sorry it's taking me longer than expected, give me just few more days ...

notes.title: Update V0.78 Critical bug

notes.title: Perfect Strike Update (v0.7+0.71)
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay Change :[/h3]
Most of the players failed in the parkour mode, so I decided to simplify the shooting system by adding a crosshair. 
The game now automatically calculates the angle of the shot based on the point of impact. 
In match mode, the system is less accurate (wider reticle).
Note : Holding the pass or kick button no longer changes the angle of the shot but increases the power of the shot.

Here is a video of the new gameplay (Spoiler : it's the full parkour of factory map)
[previewyoutube=pIdArLVwKOs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Fixed Bugs :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unable to bind mouse buttons (Thanks to Willack)
[*] The cargo of one truck was displayed when it shouldn't.
[*] The player could get stuck on some area of the factory map.
[*] In game menu losing focus
[*] Unable to create a new lobby (V0.71)
[/list]

[h3]Request :[/h3]
- Add 8 players mode by gideonp
- Unbalanced team (3v1 ...) by gideonp, now you can choose an odd number of players. (V0.71)

[h3]Other modifications :[/h3]
[list]
[*] The camera shakes is now disabled by default.
[*] Reducing light intensity.
[*] Music is now disabled during slow motion phases.
[*] Added more targets for the first parkour map.
[/list]

If you have any issue with the game or want to see something change just tell me on Steam or Discord.

The game now has is own music logic. Only 3 songs for now, Phonk based ones found on youtube with some modifications. It's quite hard to find music that can be edited, but I should find some more later (or make my own).

notes.title: New Parkour Map (Update v0.62) + VR hotfix
notes.content:
HotFix 03/07 : Add joystick support for VR controller. The game should be played with a gamepad, but Steam give now less detail about VR support, so the game VR support have been a little improved ...  Thanks to Tema 007 & Billy the kid for report

The second map is now available in Parkour mode. It's a variant of the map "Factory". This map is more difficult than the previous one because of the irregular ground. I will make a new trailer later when the music implementation is done (The game really need that).

Improved the ball control logic for irregular ground.

The red power has been improved and now creates a blast making parkour mode easier. For example it is possible to shatter all trucks windows with a well placed shot. Light objects can also be affected even if they aren't directly hit.

notes.title: Superpowers Update (v0.6)
notes.content:
[h3]New superpowers :[/h3]

This update improves the booster system by adding new skills that can be combined :
[list]
[*] The blue booster allows you to move faster by teleporting. 
[*] You can now knock out your opponent with the ball with the red booster or in "Hate mode".. 
[*] With the green booster you can control the direction of the ball (Curveball). 
[*] The yellow booster also allows you to teleport but at a lower cost. 
[/list]
This update should make the boosters more useful, and the parkour mode easier.

[previewyoutube=tVwqxcI001c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Improvements :[/h3]
The ball control system and the kick assist have been improved to give you more opportunities to make a shot.
The bot are easier in easy mode (less tackle).

[h3]Bugs fix :[/h3]
The game should now detect your screen resolution at first launch.
It was possible to on the truck in the first parkour map which stuck your character (Thanks to Salvo).
Several other minor bugs have been fixed.

As always, each new implementation introduces bugs. Feel free to report.

[h3]What's next :[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new parkour map based on the Factory map. 
[*] Phonk Music !
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Improvements (v0.52)
notes.content:
Some players are lost when it comes to gameplay. So I'm trying a new approach to make things a little more accessible. From now on you don't have to touch the ball to switch to ball control mode. You just have to be close enough.

Some players don't like it when the character goes "backwards" either. I'm not sure if I understood the complaint but now the ball must be in front of the player for the ball control to be active. Also the system is deactivated if there is an obstacle in order to make parkour easier.

I also improved the shooting system with a prediction system. The failure rate has been decreased while increasing the probability to make a shot.

The visual effects have been modified for a more cartoonish look. It's less beautiful but it improves the game performance. 

For the next update I plan to improve the booster system.

notes.title: Update 0.5 : Parkour Game Mode
notes.content:
The first map of the new parkour mode is available. It's based on the "Training Day" map. The factory map would certainly have been more interesting but the surface is irregular and I was afraid it would be too difficult to start with. 

The new parkour mode is more solo oriented but you can have visitors. It's up to you to play it cooperatively to make the best time or competitively to get more points. Players who join late are not penalized if they lose.

It's still experimental, but it should be playable without too many bugs.

[h3]Bugs :[/h3]
- It was no longer possible to see the input changes in the configuration menu. Thanks to @woemwoem for report.
- I have improved the lobby system, some new bugs may appear, let me know !

notes.title: Training tutorial and Localization (Update 0.41)
notes.content:
[h3]Tutorial :[/h3]
I finally decided to add a tutorial to the game. Some players find the game too difficult, it's true that there have been a lot of additions that make the game more complex. 
The tutorial should allow new players to get familiar with the controls smoothly, but also giving you more time to select the good settings for the game.

[h3]Localized tutorial :[/h3]
I learned 7 languages in 1 week to make the tutorial even more accessible ... It's obviously a lie, I used a translator, so there are probably many mistakes but it should be understandable (I hope). 
You can always switch back to english in options or ask for a correction on Discord or Steam.
The game should also detect the OS language and select the correct one in the first launch (not for those who have already launched the game).

[h3]Achievements :[/h3]
Finishing the tutorial unlocks the very first achievement, and there is a bonus achievement for the brave ones. 

[h3]Others :[/h3]
Removed particles effects if "special effect" is on low settings.

[h3]What next ?[/h3]
I'm going to work on a new game mode based on parkour that can be done solo (without bots) or with other players as I said before. 
A sort of challenging gameplay with achievements to unlock.
This should increase the playing time and compensate for the lack of players.


[b]Note : New implementations mean new bugs, don't be afraid to [u]contact me on Steam or Discord[/u].[/b]

notes.title: Parkour Big Update (0.4)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZlOrFXJBp5E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch notes :[/h2]

[h3]New parkour system with 20 animations :[/h3]
You are now able to climb and vault over any obstacle. Just press space near obstacle and let the game do the job.
Note : It's a new gameplay mechanism that could introduce [u]new bugs let me know on discord or steam, a video helps a lot.[/u]

[h3]New map, Factory :[/h3]
First map with obstacles, 4 times bigger than the previous ones. Not too complex for now, you can see it as a test map for the new parkour system.
Other maps, and more important, new game modes could be introduced later. I'm still thinking of a new game mode where parkour is the core of the gameplay.

[h3]3D foot placement :[/h3]
A logic for foot placement on non-flat surfaces compatible with the ball control system.

[h3]Improved HUD visibility :[/h3]
- The ball is now visible even behind objects or characters.
- Add a direction arrow when the ball is not in front of the camera.
- The status display below the character can be obscured by a 3D object, so now it can adjust his vertical position.
- Bonus are now more visible (arrow)

[h3]New actions :[/h3]
You can now lift the ball during a long kick or pass by holding the associated button longer.

[h3]Improved IA capabilities :[/h3]
IA is also able to evolve in environnement with obstacle using pathfinding. It's far from perfect but it's really complex.

[h3]New sounds and VFX :[/h3]
New sound logic and new SFX for metal, wood, dirt ...for impacts, footsteps ...

[h3]Gameplay Balance :[/h3]
- Improved supercandy spawn rate.
- Improved long kick accuracy

[h3]Others :[/h3]
- Improved netcode for 3D environement.
- Lower the first launch resolution for steam deck compatibilities.
- Randomize team option in lobby (popolingas request)

[h3]Bugs :[/h3]
Lot of bugs found, but I simply forget to take a note like the bot tackle who didn't have friction ....

notes.title: What comes next ? #2
notes.content:
I'm still working on the parkour system for the next update. I know it takes time but there are many things to add or improve. Here is a small video :

[previewyoutube=bhmUO82YN6A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: What comes next ?
notes.content:
I'm currently working to add a parkour mecanism to the game. The transition between a 2D terrain and 3D terrain involve to add some new stuffs and rework :

Here is the video : (Note: I didn't rework the map yet, I use it to test the new system in a new condition)

[previewyoutube=QgdBrCVkckI;full][/previewyoutube]

Description :
[list]
[*] A logic of foot placement on a non-flat surface compatible with the ball control system.
[*] The 3D status display attached to the character is also a problem, it can be obscured by a 3D object. I couldn't make it so that it was only occluded by moving 3D objects (ball and characters) without sacrificing game performance. So I finally decided to adjust the height of the display.
[*] The same goes for the VFX of the ball area, which was not suitable for non-flat surfaces.
[*] In a complex map, the ball could be hidden by various elements of the world. So I added the possibility to see the ball even if it is hidden. 
[*] I added a direction arrow when the ball is not in front of the camera.
[*] Finaly ajusting verticale torso rotation when punching.
[*] You can see this in the video but I have to improve the netcode prediction system.
[*] Next will be about climbing, vaulting with also a new map with new sounds (metal, wood, ...)
[/list]

notes.title: VR integration (Update V0.29)
notes.content:
[b]VR integration :[/b]
After 2 week I finally manage to set up the first version of the game compatible with Virtual Reality headsets.
I had to transform the screen interface into a 3D interface, now all menus are drawn inside the virtual world and not directly on the screen.
VR also needs a full controller support, so you can now control the mouse pointer with your controller (even if you don't use VR).
The drawback of this update is a reduction in the quality of the interface due to anti-aliasing.

[u][b]Critical bug :[/b][/u]
"Popolingas" reported me a critical bug in multiplayer, clients weren't able to move. 
I wasn't able to reproduce the issue probably related to high ping or loading time. I have made some changes but if the problem persists, please let me know.
Thanks to Popolingas and his teammates.

[b]Minor improvements  :[/b]
- VR camera stabilizator (reduce headset vibration)
- In VR mode, the 1st Person key is the VR recenter key.
- Add key (B) to switch between VR and screen rendering at anytime. (The game auto detect VR only on game launch).
- Camera shake can be disabled in the option menu (in case of motion sickness)
- Improved clinch sucess rate
- 4 players mode (2v2)

Note : [u]You need again to reset your keys binding[/u] for those who already have launched the game before.

This update may introduce new bugs, so let me know, I can't improve the game without you ...

notes.title: Update V0.17
notes.content:
[h2]NEW FEATURES :[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a radial menu for boosters (Super Candies), you can now choose the appropriate time to use them. (You may need to reset your input binding in settings menu)
[*] Collected Super Candies are now stored instead of being consumed immediately.
[*] Players start the game with one super candy of each type.
[/list]

[h3]Statistics and ranking :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a ranking system. Players start with 100 score points (lower score). This is not really a score, it's more a "value" system (I'll rename it later)..
[*] At the end of a match, players win or lose points based on the amount of points they earned during the match and the rank of their opponents.
[*] The global amount of points give a rank. (Bronze to Diamond)
[*] Rank is also showed in the lobby (Specific avatar background color)
[*] You will get some points playing alone against bots but it's just for testing it will be removed later.
[*] Add Stats : (Points per hour, Goals per hour, Win/Loss ratio)
[*] Note : Stats will be resetted later so don't take it seriously ...
[/list]

[h3]Penality system :[/h3]
[list]
[*] If a player leaves a match before the end and does not reconnect, it will lower his overall score (and also his rank).
[*] You doesn't lose points if you stop a match and you're alone against bots.
[*] You do not lose points if you join a game in progress and lose it.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Emoctiones animations weren't replicated for other players
[*] Default Region is now on "ALL" by default
[*] Credit menu was disapearing when pressing esc key, making impossible to get back to the main menu.
[*] Camera didn't take the correct position after being knocked down.
[*] Other player was looping a runing animation when loosing a round instead of walking.
[*] Saved mouse sensitivity wasn't loaded when you started a match.
[/list]

notes.title: Update V0.16
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RSo3unV6wZw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Interface Update :[/h3] [list]
[*] Added a radial menu : Integration of a radial menu for the emoctiones, a similar system will be implemented for the super candies. /!\ You need to reset inputs to default values.
[*] Added tooltips for the host menu.
[*] Added a custom cursor that adjusts its size depending on the screen resolution.
[*] Added system messages : For example, if someone logs in or out, a message will appear in the text chat.
[*] Improved text chat : Now messages slowly vanish from screen after 15s.
[*] The reset key binding to default is now extented to all actions.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Update :[/h3] [list]
[*] Added a rotation spawn system : Now after each round players appear at a different location.
[*] Improved ball control : Note : it's a first step, I'm going to rework completely the system for a semi automated system later.
[*] The reset key binding to default is now extented to all actions.
[*] Now when a player is disconnect for more than 2 min another player will be able to join the game (if join in progress was selected).
[/list]
[h3]Fixes :[/h3] [list]
[*] Speed rotation with a controller was greatly reduced when reseting key binding.
[*] It wasn't possible to reconnect on the same server after a disconnection.
[*] When a player left the game during the initial countdown, the bot were able to move before the en of the countdown.
[/list]

notes.title: Update V0.15
notes.content:
[h1]V 0.15 Hotfixes :[/h1]
[list]
[*] When a player leaves a game, a bot will immediately takes his place.
[*] Some sounds were disabled for new players waiting as spectators.
[*] Camera was bugged because of bots, they rotate again at the end of a round.
[*] Corrected an issue with the camera orientation after a round when playing with bots.
[*] Camera position is not affected anymore by other characters.
[*] Goal net physics has been improved.
[*] Add a limit to the ball max speed.
[*] Improving AI ball interception (Thanks to EmperShadows).
[*] Rebalancing shadows options for better performance on mid range computers.
[*] Reducing the leg hitbox size when shooting or kicking.
[/list]

notes.title: Update V0.14b
notes.content:
- You can now start a game as a spectator with only bots (EmperShadows request).

notes.title: Update V0.14 : BOTS
notes.content:
[h3]Bots implementation :[/h3]
You can now play against bots. Just click on the "bot" button in the lobby near your avatar name.

[h3]Join In Progress :[/h3]
You can select this option in the host menu to allow players to join your game in progress. They will have to wait for the next round to take a bot slot.

[h3]Fixes : [/h3]
[list]
[*] Add a limitation to avoid player getting out from the arena (Thanks to Smokahontas).
[*] Improving clinch to reduce hand shaking  (Thanks to EmperShadows and Salvo_k27).
[*] Fixed ball being stuck in corners.
[*] Fixed stamina that doesn't recover (Salvo_k27).
[*] Fixed player being free after a kick (Salvo_k27).
[*] Sighly improved Bot hate mode (EmperShadows).
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.12
notes.content:
[h3]Smoothing Turn speed :[/h3] 
Add acceleration when you start to turn your character. This should improve the gameplay with a keyboard.

[h3]Aim assist :[/h3] 
It's not really an aim assit, the direction of your character won't change but the upper body will turn toward the opponent in front of you. If they are multiple opponents, it will aim at the closest one to the ball deviation indicator. Punching and grabbing will now be easier. This may introduce new bugs.

[h3]Hot fixes :[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Removed the commentator option when you start a game alone.
[*] Critical bug : The character was detaching from the control center. I was unable to reproduce this issue but I made some modifications who should avoid this situation .Thanks to Salvo K27.
[/list]

I put a small video on Twitter about this :
https://twitter.com/Self_MADev/status/1471928038476689418

notes.title: Join the Alpha Test
notes.content:
To be able to test the 3v3 gameplay, the Alpha Test of No Fair Play will start now. If you are interested, you can join the "No Fair Play" Discord : https://discord.gg/Mu9TcSMXf9 or the steam group chat https://s.team/chat/MKyEkPYt

[h3][b]Conditions to obtain a free key :[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 5 Steam account
[*] You have to stay in the Discord or your key could be disabled. The reason is simple, it will be easier to find who is currently playing the game.
[/list]

[h3][b]Important notes :[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Servers are filtered by regions. Select the correct region before hosting or searching a game. This will reduce chance to play with a distant player with a big ping. 
[*] The game need low pings, above 200ms you could endure some major issues.
[*] You should avoid to host a game if you have a low-end computer or a bad internet connection.
[/list]
